programs.title: Emergency
programs.desc: A surfer has a heart attack while out in the water. Dr Caitlin and Dr Martin are not sure they can save him. Dr Mya helps a mum with agonising leg injuries after she was squashed between a motorbike and 4WD.

programs.title: Emergency
programs.desc: Dr Mya’s stabbing victim is hanging on to life as he bleeds heavily. Dr David’s patient has potential spinal injuries after crashing onto his head during a mountain bike race. Milo is a hit with Dr Emma during bring your dog to work day.

programs.title: Emergency
programs.desc: Emergency responders face real-life crises, including accidents, medical emergencies, and rescue operations. The show follows paramedics, police, and firefighters as they handle high-pressure situations. Through real footage and firsthand accounts, it reveals the intensity and urgency of emergency services.
